newsitem.title: NICARAGUA: Last remnants of Nicaragua's Contras agree to peace.
newsitem.headline: Last remnants of Nicaragua's Contras agree to peace.

text.p: Nicaragua's final surviving armed group, Frente Norte 3-80, signed a peace and disarmament agreement with the government on Friday.

In an official act at the presidential palace, the leaders of the armed group promised to hand in their weapons before June 15. They were a leftover from the now-defunct Contras, an armed band that during the 1980s attacked the previous Sandinista governments.
The government in turn agreed to a partial amnesty, creating eight temporary havens and beginning development programmes for the 689 people in a preliminary list of disarmed guerrillas.
"We feel very satisfied because we were given the opportunity to contribute to the peace process," the head of the group, Mario Herrera, known as "Pajarillo", said.
Nicaraguan president Arnoldo Aleman said the accord "ends armed violence in all its dimensions."
